**Observation Log:**

[FACT] User is looking for a home warranty to protect their new place from unexpected repairs.  
[EVENT] User has been searching for a home for a while.  
[EVENT] User saw a property in Cedar Creek on February 1st that was out of their budget.  
[TEMPORAL] Session date is 2023/03/08 (Wed) at 20:23.  
[ASSISTANT] Assistant provided a list of home warranty providers and their prices, including American Home Shield, HomeServe USA, Old Republic Home Warranty, First American Home Warranty, Choice Home Warranty, and Select Home Warranty.  
[ASSISTANT] Assistant mentioned that prices for home warranties typically range from $299 to $600 per year, with service fees between $75 and $125.  
[ASSISTANT] Assistant provided average response times for claims, indicating 24-48 hours for initial response and 3-5 business days for service appointment scheduling.  
[ASSISTANT] Assistant outlined common exclusions and limitations of home warranties, including maintenance-related issues, pre-existing conditions, code violations, high-end items, cosmetic issues, age and wear-and-tear, and acts of nature.  
[ASSISTANT] Assistant explained how providers determine whether an issue is maintenance-related and suggested prioritizing regular maintenance tasks to avoid voiding the warranty.  
[ASSISTANT] Assistant detailed how service fees work, including the typical range of $75 to $125, and provided tips for minimizing service fees, such as choosing a provider with lower fees and scheduling multiple services at once.  
[ASSISTANT] Assistant advised the user to keep a maintenance log or calendar to track maintenance activities and follow manufacturer instructions for upkeep.  
[ASSISTANT] Assistant suggested that regular maintenance can help prevent issues and reduce the risk of voiding the warranty.
